data.body:
[P2] Preserve the lifecycle cause when cancellation interrupts owner cleanup

When the handler returns with an async step still running, caller interruption or cleanup expiry can interrupt the root inside `manager.drainOperations()`. That drain uses the default `DrainFailure`, which converts interruption into `IllegalStateException`. The fallback below passes this synthetic error to End, bypassing the recorded lifecycle failure. Consequently, plugins and OTel record a different error from the retryable lifecycle failure returned to the caller, obscuring the original timeout/interruption diagnosis. After preserving fatal precedence, use the recorded lifecycle failure for cancellation-caused drain errors and retain the drain error as a suppressed diagnostic. Add a regression that cancels while the root is already draining an async step.
